title: Rate Card Note — The Allowance Set Against a Settlement for Points Read by an Energy Monitoring Subscription
content:
# Rate Card Note — The Allowance Set Against a Settlement for Points Read by an Energy Monitoring Subscription

**The allowance.** Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from the controls system, one month of that subscription's own fee for each meter it covers is set against the sum required to settle the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans, the point licence being carried on the automation plan rather than there. Where an energy monitoring subscription the owner holds stands active and reads its data from both the controls system and its own meters, half that amount is set against the sum required. In every other case no allowance at all is set against it. The allowance is taken to two decimal places.

The subscription, its standing, the source its data is drawn from, the meters it covers and its own fee for each meter are read from the office's records of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions held by that owner.

| Energy monitoring subscription standing active | The source its data is drawn from | Allowance set against the sum required |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the controls system | one month of that subscription's own fee for each meter it covers |
| yes | both the controls system and its own meters | half a month of that subscription's own fee for each meter it covers |
| yes | its own meters only | none |
| no | not read | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

An owner holds a subscription under the Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions standing active, covering 18 meters at a fee of 24 USD a meter a year, drawing its data from the controls system. One month of that fee for each meter is 24 USD divided by twelve, that is 2 USD a meter, so the allowance is 18 multiplied by 2 USD, that is 36.00 USD. Were the subscription drawing its data from both the controls system and its own meters, the allowance would be half that, 18.00 USD.
